description: This file defines the CacheNotificationResponseHeader class, which represents a response header indicating notification presence and the last fetch timestamp within the notification cache for the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: CacheNotificationResponseHeader
classes.description: A class encapsulating notification cache response header details, including whether notifications are present and the timestamp of the last fetch.

methods.name: CacheNotificationResponseHeader
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing hasNotifications and lastFetch fields.

methods.name: hasNotifications
methods.description: Getter method for hasNotifications indicating presence of notifications.

methods.name: getLastFetch
methods.description: Getter method for the timestamp of the last fetch.

methods.name: setLastFetch
methods.description: Setter method to update lastFetch timestamp.
